sloka: पुष्पाणि च सुगन्धीनि क्रियतां तेषु नित्यशः ।परिवार्य यथा मे स्युरध्यर्धं योजनं तथा ।। ७.५४.१२ ॥
transliteration: puṣpāṇi ca sugandhīni kriyatāṁ teṣu nityaśaḥ ।parivārya yathā me syuradhyardhaṁ yojanaṁ tathā ।। 7.54.12 ॥

translations.english: Let fragrant flowers always be placed in them, surrounding the area for me to a distance of one and a half Yojanas.
